porous_transport.note: Darcy and mixture-diffusion relations from existing gas_transport.py and pore source records. Common molar-frame D, viscosity power laws and evolving brick properties are assumed. No Knudsen or Soret prediction; reciprocal-logarithmic carried-enthalpy mean preserves the stated ideal-gas entropy inequality.

quartz_nist.note: Existing local source. Source alpha/beta Cp, 847 K transition, 728 J/mol rounded JANAF latent increment. Metastable quartz extrapolation across actual high-T polymorph region remains an approximation.

solid_effective.note: Thermodynamic free-energy construction reused in an axial effective skeleton. Modulus, background expansion and quartz transition eigenstrain are explicit engineering assumptions, not measured brick properties. The transition eigenstrain follows the existing caloric phase fraction and initial quartz reference-volume fraction; not a pure-phase molar-volume or stress-dependent equilibrium law. USGS volumes at different temperatures cannot identify the isothermal phase jump.

effective_conductivity.note: Engineering closure for effective dry-solid connectivity and liquid pore filling, not a measured homogenization law. Fourier transport uses positive state-dependent k and series half-cell resistances; no extra stored or reaction energy. Exponent and liquid-volume gain are uncalibrated assumptions. Initial dry reference fraction is derived from root recipe and constituent molar volumes.

lumped_carbonization.note: Explicit engineering CH2O -> C + H2O pathway using existing proxy species, atom-balanced stoichiometry and the same formation enthalpy/entropy reference. Not a fitted sludge pyrolysis spectrum. Arrhenius coefficients and common reactivity of initial/generated char are assumed; no new independent reaction heat.

effective_liquid_phase.note: Engineering fluxed-matrix proxy carried by a fraction of current metakaolin, with unchanged Al2Si2O7 composition and molar volume. Two-state free energy gives equilibrium liquid fraction, latent enthalpy and entropy; these parameters are not pure metakaolin melting properties, measured mineral fractions or a phase diagram. No kinetic hysteresis or quenched glass.

pore_radiation.note: Declared local equilibrium pore-wall radiation closure: k_rad=4*sigma*exchange_factor*current_pore_diameter*gas_porosity*T^3. The factor represents unmeasured wall exchange and geometry, not a spectral emissivity measurement. Pore diameter inherits the assumed sintering-radius geometry; no independent optical length or spectral transport.

liquid_water_transport.note: Declared Onsager liquid-water closure with availability-weighted positive mobility and shared transported enthalpy. Mechanical potential is supplemented by the separately declared water_retention free energy in the current model. No wetting hysteresis or measured hydraulic conductivity. The diffusivity-dimensional coefficient is a mobility scale, not a measured Fick diffusivity.

water_retention.note: Explicit ideal-mixing free energy RT*[n*ln(n/(n+N))+N*ln(N/(n+N))], where N is an immobile dry-matrix equivalent scale, not an extra mass inventory or measured maximum sorption capacity. Gives water activity n/(n+N), mixing entropy and zero excess internal energy/enthalpy. No energetic binding, fitted isotherm, hysteresis or evolving matrix sites.

water_phase_exchange.note: Declared seeded phase kinetics: both signed directions oppose the same water/vapor chemical-potential difference and share the evaporation Arrhenius rate. Bounded driving functions give finite log-inventory rates. Reverse prefactor proportional to existing liquid; no exactly dry nucleation, measured condensation law or resolved interface area. At unit factor paired one-way flux ratio exp(-affinity).

liquid_relaxation.note: Declared nonequilibrium extension of the existing two-state free energy: log-odds q relaxes toward its equilibrium value, with positive Arrhenius rate. Carrier birth inherits local disordered fraction; phase energy and entropy derivatives are explicit. No measured glass-transition or crystallization kinetics.

water_binding.note: Declared saturating water-binding Helmholtz energy g(n)*a(T), g=N*n/(n+N); a=-E+C*(T-Tr-T*ln(T/Tr)). Positive excess capacity and convex composition free energy. Coefficients are engineering assumptions, not measured sorption heats.

gas_program.note: Predeclared virtual kiln reservoir composition at thermal-stage endpoints, linearly interpolated with process time. No plant atmosphere measurements, kiln circulation/combustion solution or recipe optimization.

thermal.solid_fraction_exponent.note: Power of current dry-solid volume fraction divided by initial dry reference fraction. Porosity includes liquid plus gas for this closure. Zero removes the solid-fraction correction.

thermal.liquid_volume_gain.note: Dimensionless liquid-water volume correction to the nonradiative background. At fixed total pore fraction, replacing gas with liquid increases the background conductivity. Setting this coefficient and the solid-fraction exponent to zero restores constant background k, while pore radiation requires its own zero factor.

kinetics.organic_carbonization.A.note: Effective proxy Arrhenius prefactor; zero disables only this pathway for an explicit mechanism comparison.

kinetics.organic_carbonization.E.note: Effective activation energy for the single assumed CH2O carbonization pathway, not a measured pyrolysis distribution.

kinetics.oxygen_reference_pressure.note: Fixed kinetic normalization pressure. Unlike inlet pressure normalization, it does not change when oxygen-poor reservoir conditions are selected.

liquid.active_matrix_fraction.note: Fraction of current metakaolin carrying the declared two-state matrix proxy; carrier birth inherits local phase fraction. Zero removes latent storage, kinetic phase state and mobility coupling.

liquid.transition_temperature.note: Effective equal-free-energy temperature of the two-state matrix proxy, not a pure mineral melting temperature.

liquid.latent_heat.note: Enthalpy contrast per mole of active proxy matrix. Shared by caloric storage and chemical potentials; no separate heat source.

liquid.transition_width.note: Sets ideal two-state mixing coefficient b=L*width/Tm^2; fraction slope at Tm is 1/(4*width). Not a fitted distribution.

liquid.mobility_gain.note: Existing sintering mobility multiplied by exp(gain*effective_liquid_volume/dry_condensed_volume). Zero keeps latent storage but disables this kinetic multiplier.

thermal.pore_radiation_factor.note: Effective wall-exchange/geometry factor in the local diffusion approximation. Zero removes only internal pore radiation, preserving exterior furnace radiation. Optical length is an evolving pore diameter, not a mesh-cell width.

transport.liquid_water_mobility.note: Mobility scale D in L=2*A*D/[R*(dx_left/c_left+dx_right/c_right)]. Internal liquid-water flux J=L*F, F=volume*mean(1/T)*difference(p_gas-P_ext-p_cap)+R*difference(log(water_activity)). Zero removes only liquid-water redistribution; boundary liquid flux is zero. Not measured hydraulic or drying diffusivity.

water.retention_scale.note: Water-equivalent mass scale per initial dry mass defining fixed matrix equivalents N for mixing and saturated binding. Not added matter, a measured site count or maximum sorption capacity. Zero N recovers pure liquid and removes binding.

kinetics.condensation.factor.note: Reverse phase-exchange factor multiplying the evaporation Arrhenius coefficient and existing liquid inventory for positive vapor-minus-liquid affinity. One gives symmetric bounded driving and paired flux ratio exp(-affinity); zero disables condensation and recovers the previous one-way law. Fixed at one in this conditional UQ; not a measured accommodation coefficient.

liquid.relaxation_time_ref.note: Log-odds relaxation time at the existing effective transition temperature. Zero selects the previous algebraic equilibrium model; positive values define kinetic mode. Not an experimentally measured crystallization time.

liquid.relaxation_activation_energy.note: Assumed Arrhenius barrier for log-odds relaxation; cooling reduces rate and may retain disordered proxy material. Not fitted to measured viscosity or glass transition.

water.binding_energy.note: Positive binding-energy magnitude at the existing thermodynamic reference temperature. The free-energy term is -E*g at that temperature; not a measured adsorption enthalpy.

water.binding_heat_capacity.note: Positive excess heat capacity per effective bound equivalent. Constant over the virtual schedule; no experimental high-temperature adsorption law. With zero binding energy and zero capacity, recover preceding ideal-mixing retention.

process.binding_drying_extension.note: Predeclared additional virtual dry hold for one bounded response to binding-induced endpoint failure. parameter_snapshot.uncertainty_scope_note: Twenty-four selected parameters include water binding energy and excess heat capacity, liquid relaxation, retention scale and liquid mobility. Permeability, pore radius, condensation factor and evaporation A/E remain fixed, as do liquid latent contrast and transition width. Eight paired samples do not establish all-parameter, sorption-heat, glass-yield or permeability-range robustness. Added sampled dimensions change other draws; cross-ensemble differences cannot be assigned to binding alone. Stage composition endpoints and program scale are fixed at the predeclared virtual recipe; the same 24-dimensional paired draws as the water-binding stage are retained. This is not robustness to kiln-atmosphere uncertainty or optimization over endpoint-qualified processes.

baseline.scope: Source-traceable full firing-cycle approximation with thermodynamic water binding, stored pore gas and prescribed staged kiln atmosphere; real material applicability pending measurements.

kiln_gas_program.limitation: No kiln combustion, circulation or finite external inventory. Reservoir composition enters boundary partial pressure, donor transport and entropy exchange at the same time; stored pore gas is never reset. External composition changes add no separate internal energy source. Gas-storage-zero historical host remains constant-inlet.

baseline.gas_approximation: Stored ideal O2/N2/H2O/CO2 gas, common-D molar diffusion plus donor Darcy flow with entropy-compatible carried enthalpy; assumed diffusivity and pore properties. No imposed internal pressure or independent per-cell sweep.
baseline.thermal_approximation: Background k=k_ref*(dry_solid_fraction/initial_dry_solid_fraction)^m*(1+b*liquid_water_volume_fraction), plus local pore-wall radiative k=4*sigma*factor*length*gas_porosity*T^3. Length is 2*r_initial*(pore_volume/initial_pore_volume)^(1/3), independent of mesh width. The assumed exchange factor includes wall emissivity and geometry; one local equilibrium temperature, no spectral/nonlocal photon or participating-gas radiation. Shared face and external half-cell resistances use total k; exterior furnace radiation remains a separate boundary exchange. No extra stored photon energy or separate radiation heat source. No intrinsic mineral conductivity law; coefficients unmeasured.
baseline.liquid_water_transport_approximation: Migration and seeded phase exchange share mechanical, ideal-mixing and energetic-binding water potential. Positive series availability multiplies the shared-face entropy force. Carried enthalpy uses reciprocal-log thermal mean, arithmetic mean mechanical potential times molar volume, and mean binding composition derivative times binding enthalpy at the thermal mean. Binding force is difference(g_prime)*mean(a(T)/T), satisfying the same nonisothermal entropy identity. No independent heat of transport. Log water inventory permits influx/loss; zero exterior/center liquid flow. No measured hydraulic law, dry-surface nucleation, hysteresis or humidity-cycle validation.
baseline.water_retention_approximation: Ideal-mixing free energy plus binding F_b=g*a(T), g=N*n/(n+N), a=-E+C*(T-Tr-T*ln(T/Tr)). Fixed matrix equivalents N are an assumed scale, not added matter or measured sites. Binding U=g*(-E+C*(T-Tr)), S=g*C*ln(T/Tr), Cp=g*C; partial water h/s and mu use g_prime=(N/(n+N))^2, distinct from storage coefficient g. Reported water activity includes exp(mu_binding/(R*T)); mixing activity is also separately retained. Binding is an assumed saturating equilibrium free energy with constant excess Cp, not measured adsorption heat, a separate bound-water phase or site evolution. Zero E and C restore preceding mixing-only model; zero N removes mixing and binding.
baseline.water_phase_exchange_approximation: Let a=(mu_vapor-mu_water)/(R*T), k=A_evap*exp(-E_evap/(R*T)). Net vapor source is k*n_water*(1-exp(a)) for a<=0, and -factor*k*n_water*(1-exp(-a)) for a>0. Unit factor gives paired forward/backward flux ratio exp(-a). Both directions use the same stoichiometry and formation-energy ledger, without extra latent heat. Reverse prefactor is proportional to existing liquid: positive seeded water can regrow, but exactly dry-surface nucleation is absent. Log water inventory and its finite signed hazard are retained without floors. No measured condensation coefficient, interface area or accommodation law; reverse factor fixed in UQ.
baseline.reaction_approximation: Competing organic oxidation and lumped CH2O -> C + H2O carbonization share the organic inventory. Char inventory receives carbonization products and loses oxidation products; it is not overwritten by an initial-char depletion formula. All pathways use the same stoichiometry, formation-energy reference and affinity. No complete pyrolysis spectrum or distinct char reactivity populations. Conversion denominators are initial reactant moles, except char oxidation uses initial char plus potential organic carbon.

thermodynamics.liquid_relaxation_entropy_domain: Nonnegative per-active-mole kinetic dissipation, with carrier inventory subject to the existing declared inventory error budget. Raw extensive entropy is retained, including signed values from near-zero carrier roundoff; no clipping or new tolerance.

baseline.solid_approximation: Effective constant-area axial equilibrium skeleton with assumed modulus, background expansion and quartz transition eigenstrain. Transition strain follows the caloric fraction weighted by inert quartz reference volume; not a measured pure-phase molar-volume law. No stress-dependent phase equilibrium, hysteresis, bending or fracture.
baseline.liquid_approximation: Finite-rate disordered/ordered two-state proxy carried by an assumed fraction of current metakaolin, sharing composition and molar volume. Log-odds q relaxes toward q_eq(T) with Arrhenius rate; x=logistic(q). Phase energy N*L*x and entropy N*[x*L/Tm-b*(x*log(x)+(1-x)*log(1-x))] use the preceding reference offsets. Carrier formation inherits the local x, accounted for through averaged molar h/s and reaction affinity; only N*dx is internal phase relaxation. No independent crystallization/nucleation law, measured glass transition, mineral phase diagram, phase volume jump or liquid transport. Retained disordered material on cooling is a glass proxy, not measured glass yield; the original temperature-dependent sintering mobility remains in force.

constitutive_calculations.method: One-off physical identities and exact previous fixed-boundary limits; no software test files or measurement claims.
constitutive_calculations.note: System U/S depend on the current internal state; the prescribed external composition only enters boundary exchange. No derivative of reservoir composition is added to the internal energy or species inventories.

additional_difference_denominator: Absolute refined value; all listed values are nonzero. These auxiliary peak diagnostics are separate from the primary engineering gate.

threshold.note: Engineering endpoint reporting criterion for the example.

failures.response: Retain one predeclared curve and failure. No atmosphere/temperature/binding/tolerance search. Historical fixed and two-hour extension failures remain unchanged.
Preserve all records and fixed program; no tuning or repeated ensemble.
Parameter recovery is not process qualification; same-model synthetic and all fitted statuses remain assumed.

failures.cause: One-off reporting script treated scenario metadata objects as scenario ids. Three result copies had completed; the aggregate and Markdown had not been written.
failures.response: Read actual scenario schema and use each id; preserve copied results. No model rerun or numerical change.

fixed_control.exit_scope: physical consistency; historical drying endpoint remains failed

uq.exit_scope: All physical consistency checks, not process endpoint qualification.

calibration.exit_scope: Synthetic parameter recovery and final forward physical consistency, not process endpoint qualification.

limits: Prescribed uniform external reservoir, no kiln circulation, combustion or finite supply model.
Program values are wet molar fractions, not relative humidity; all unmeasured assumptions.
Recipe fixed in 24-parameter conditional UQ, no atmosphere-uncertainty or feasible-process optimization claim.
Synthetic fitting of three existing parameters cannot identify the unvaried atmosphere recipe.
Atmosphere and temperature share stage-end times. Longer-hold scenario changes gas-segment timing too; comparison is of coupled programs, not a fixed-clock atmosphere intervention.
next_development: Water-retention site evolution tied to existing dehydroxylation inventory, including composition derivatives in chemical affinity and energy/entropy.

field_retention.scope: Only this stage temporary full trajectory, after required summaries were retained. No historical or unique compressed files affected; no total-storage remeasurement.

conditional_uq.ranking_scope: All 24 records including 15 failed drying endpoints, not an optimization over qualified processes. Paired samples have the same drying program; longer-hold scenario shifts the common atmosphere and temperature stage clock.

delivery_timing_note: Parallel computation durations are not added; commit/push/remote verification and full wall time are recorded separately in the local/private delivery receipt.
